name: CENNETIC T850 High-Speed Drilling & Tapping Center
summary: The T850 is a high-speed drilling and tapping center for fast hole-making and light milling on aluminum and small steel parts in high-volume production.
body:

About this model

This Drilling & Tapping Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
